sections.heading: iPod (5th generation) – also known as iPod with video or Fifth Generation iPod
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Click Wheel
Capacity: 30 and 60 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1238: October 2005
The iPod (5th generation) is a hard drive-based iPod featuring a large, widescreen colour display, a Click Wheel, and the capability of displaying photos and videos. It uses USB for syncing.
The iPod (5th generation) comes in white and black.
